title: Stoke Space heading
description: An extra-wide, heavy, all-caps display heading in three fluid sizes (hero, section, compact), set tight with line-height under 1 on phones.
notes: reads the stokespace theme's --stokespace-stretch and --stokespace-widen; under other themes it is the display face at normal width
best with a font that has a width axis (Archivo, Mona Sans)
